snippet.title: NUKO Trailer- IndieMania 2026
snippet.description:
The world is ending! The only way you can afford to build your bunker in time is to play NUKO: A fast paced bluffing gameshow.
Play the game to earn credits, customize your bunker, collect endangered species. Plus, solve the mystery as to why the world is ending! Team up with friends to take on a variety of wild and crafty contestants. Can you survive the apocalypse?

IndieMania is the ultimate online event for indie game lovers. It’s a digital showcase of the best indie games from developers all around the world, featuring exclusive demos, interviews, live streams, and more. Whether you’re into action, adventure, puzzle, or simulation, you’ll find something to suit your taste at IndieMania.
